messages:
nora (PM): quick sync — Customer BetaCorp asked for a safe onboarding path for `model-x` into our catalog. They want per-tenant sampling, a clear rollback story, and a way to keep a tiny legacy fallback for 30d after cutover. What is the minimal spec we can ship this sprint?
ben (Eng): minimal runtime pieces: (1) per-tenant pin record, (2) routing override with `pct` and `grace_mode`, (3) automatic fallback rule tied to alerts. storage in feature-flags + lightweight mapping cache.
farah (Research): sampling: recommend stratified sampling across 3 axes — prompt length (S/M/L), intent (generate/qa/rerank), and tenant traffic tier. Start with 3k paired queries per cohort (v1 vs v0). Metrics: embedding cosine, normalized logprob delta, token-length shift. Also keep 200 manual spot-check examples daily.
otto (SRE): ops constraints: must have a circuit-breaker that halts routing changes if global p95 increases >30ms or error-rate spike >0.4% sustained for 10m. Also add a cost cap per-cohort to avoid runaway spend. We'll expose an `estimated_cost_delta` in preflight.
kira (CS): comms + UX asks: show "legacy fallback until" date in console, include an audit row (who pinned/unpinned + timestamp), and a one-click Unpin for CS. Customers want CSV export of pinned tenants and TTLs.
ben (Eng): tentative API proto:
```
POST /v1/catalog/pins
body: {tenant_id, model_id, pct, ttl_days, grace_mode}
```
`pct` is percent of tenant traffic routed to new model; `grace_mode` toggles shim transforms for changed fields. We'll default ttl_days=30 if not supplied.
farah (Research): acceptance thresholds proposal: embed_cosine_mean >= 0.94; median logprob_delta within [-0.12, 0.06]; human-spot-fail_rate < 1.5% over 200 samples. If thresholds breach -> mark cohort unhealthy.
otto (SRE): alert rules:
- if embed_cos_drop_rate > 2% for 30m -> auto-rollback for that cohort
- if p95_latency_delta > 50ms for 15m -> pause ramp and page #oncall
I'll also add a `cohort_state` tag so dashboards can filter.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: model-x -> internal-beta at 2026-08-02T10:00:00Z. monitors: p95_latency_by_cohort, embed_cosine_mean, cost_delta_estimate. :rocket:
kira (CS): legal/customer ask: can we offer per-tenant extended pins (60/90 days) via CS-approved workflow? they may need extra runway.
ben (Eng): yes — admin endpoint `POST /admin/pins/extend {tenant_id, days}` with RBAC and audit logging. Plus a console prompt for CS to pick 30/60/90.
farah (Research): evaluation pipeline output path: `s3://redwood-evals/betacorp/model-x/{cohort}/` — include pairwise diffs and top 20 failing examples for quick triage.
Nora (PM): acceptance criteria (MVP): 1) API + console for per-tenant pin with pct + ttl + grace_mode, 2) eval harness + S3 output, 3) SRE dashboards + automated rollback triggers, 4) CS UI for Unpin + extend, 5) preflight cost estimate in pin creation. If any of the rollback triggers hit during canary -> immediate rollback + CS notif.
ben (Eng): I'll land the API + feature-flag mapping. plan to store cohort metadata in `catalog-pins` table. will push a small rollback cli: `rctl catalog rollback --cohort COHORT`.
otto (SRE): I'll wire alerts and add a runbook step that lists the rollback reason + attaches the top 10 failing prompts to the incident.
kira (CS): I'll draft customer email templates and the console copy for TTLs + expected cost. Also will gather the list of contract-bound tenants who need 30d notice.
farah (Research): I'll prep canonical sample sets and wire the evaluator to tag examples that violate thresholds.
Nora (PM): good — owners assigned (Ben, Otto, Farah, Kira). Follow-up demo Fri 11am. small note: keep messages short in the runbook, include `rctl` snippets and example console screenshots.
